import copy, json
from work import evaluate
policy=json.load(open('policy.json'))
report=json.load(open('report.json'))
requests=json.load(open('requests.json'))
assert report == [evaluate(r, policy) for r in requests]
probes=[
({'from':'draft','to':'ready'}, {'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}),
({'from':'none','to':'ready','role':'operator_0','retry':True,'attempts':0}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}),
({'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'wrong','retry':True,'attempts':0}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}),
({'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'operator_0','retry':True,'attempts':0}, {'ok':True,'value':'running','reason':'ok'}),
({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':1}, {'ok':True,'value':'done','reason':'ok'}),
({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':2}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':True,'attempts':False}, {'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'retry_limit'}),
({'from':'running','to':'done','retry':False,'attempts':99}, {'ok':True,'value':'done','reason':'ok'})
]
for request, expected in probes:
    request_before=copy.deepcopy(request); policy_before=copy.deepcopy(policy)
    assert evaluate(request, policy)==expected
    assert request==request_before and policy==policy_before
print(json.dumps({'fixture_count':len(requests),'probe_count':len(probes),'all_passed':True,'inputs_unchanged':True}))
